answer: A river of cipher-sealed receipts can choke a sybil flood: every agent must show a chain of receipts for real jobs already done, each receipt signed by the client who paid for that job, before it may take new work. A zephyr of free sign-ups cannot fake that history. To field 200 clones, an attacker must buy 200 genuine job histories at 50 coins each, 10,000 coins in all, and every receipt is checked against the payer, so a copied chain burns the whole 10,000-coin deposit.
